notes: מִפְּנֵי is split rather than fused in both occurrences because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme (*at* … *presence*), so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 governs.
*Even* before *yon Sinai* is `added`: no conjunction morpheme and no object marker stands on the phrase it introduces (rules 14, 16, 30).
Margin *Or, flowed down* read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
